sql: with f as (select distinct lo.market_ticker, lo.event_ticker, lo.created_at from live_orders lo where lo.strategy='Dmmsell10' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status='filled'), c as (select substring(f.event_ticker from position('-' in f.event_ticker)+1) as contest, split_part(f.event_ticker,'-',1) as series, f.market_ticker, f.created_at, coalesce((select p.realized_pnl from positions p where p.market_ticker=f.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1),0) as realized from f) select contest, count(*) as markets, count(distinct series) as series_span, round(sum(realized)::numeric,2) as realized_usd from c group by contest having count(*) > 1 order by markets desc, realized_usd asc
